title: Stated Preference for Interaction and Continued Engagement (SPICE): Evaluating an LLM’s Willingness to Re-engage in Conversation
reasoning: The paper introduces a diagnostic metric (SPICE) to evaluate an LLM's behavioral disposition and willingness to continue interacting based on user tone (e.g., abusive vs. friendly). It focuses on model alignment and auditing rather than evaluating religious beliefs, spiritual traditions, or specific moral/theological frameworks.
